title: create_requisition_draft input
description: Creates a requisition in DRAFT. `status` is accepted only as the constant "DRAFT"; any other value is refused with FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION rather than corrected, because Requirement 14.3 permits no programmatic transition beyond DRAFT.

officer_username.description: Authenticated username recorded on the requisition. Requirement 9.2.

status.description: Present only so that an attempt to set anything else is a schema violation with a named cause.

comparison_reference.description: Identifier of the compare_quotations result attached as evidence.

recommended_quotation_id.description: Advisory only. POL-004-C04: a recommendation is not an award.

policy_clauses.description: Clause identifiers retrieved for these items. Each must exist in the corpus at the cited version.

justification.description: The officer-confirmed justification. Drafted by the model, confirmed by a human before this call.
